nodes.name: Read the documents
nodes.notes:
Copy your documents in first:
docker compose cp ./docs-pack n8n:/home/node/docs-pack

nodes.name: Embed the chunk
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential. The key never appears in this node, which is why this file is safe to share.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO kb (source, chunk_index, content, embedding)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2::int,
  $3,
  -- The embedding arrives as a JSON array of numbers and is cast here. Passing
  -- it as a JSON string rather than a raw array keeps it a bound parameter.
  (SELECT array_agg(x::float8) FROM json_array_elements_text($4::json) AS x)
)
ON CONFLICT (source, chunk_index) DO UPDATE
  SET content    = EXCLUDED.content,
      embedding  = EXCLUDED.embedding,
      created_at = now();
